People and Stories
Core Values of Employees

  • Passionate

    Going the Extra Mile

  • Attentive

    Listening to Every Need

  • Flexible

    Embracing Innovative Thinking

  • Sincere

    Showing Deep Care

  • Professional

    Acting with Swiftness
  • Sincere. Showing Deep Care • Attentive. Listening to Every Need

    During the pandemic, when loved ones couldn't gather, old family photos became even more precious. An elderly resident accidentally deleted photos from their phone and found themselves alone at home, unable to reminisce about better times. In desperation, they sought help from our service center. Our colleague, after understanding the situation, patiently guided the resident on how to recover the photos. During this time, they also conversed with the resident, and passing maintenance colleagues greeted the elder, showing care and warmth. This sincere interaction made the resident feel less lonely, even during such trying times.

  • Passionate. Going the Extra Mile • Professional. Acting with Swiftness

    Rescue operations are always a race against time. Recently, a customer collapsed on a footbridge near the mall due to severe heart pain. A bystander immediately sought help from the mall, and two of our colleagues rushed to the scene. Despite the sudden nature of the incident, they remained calm and composed, using their training to quickly coordinate: one colleague called an ambulance and managed the scene, while the other closely monitored the customer's condition, comforting and staying with them until the ambulance arrived. They also reassured other onlookers, keeping them calm. Their teamwork and swift action helped the customer through the crisis. The customer later sent a letter of appreciation, praising their professionalism and compassionate service.

  • Professional. Acting with Swiftness • Attentive. Listening to Every Need

    With modern advancements, residential properties have introduced many new services. Yet, our employees never forget to uphold the principle of "putting ourselves in others shoes," always considering the residents perspectives. Recently, a family was trapped inside their unit due to a malfunctioning electronic lock and called for help. Our team promptly arrived, assessed the situation, and solved the problem with professionalism and teamwork. While one colleague inspected the lock, others used a lift platform to comfort the elderly and children inside. They not only contacted a locksmith but also personally delivered supplies to the residents. Their thoughtful actions earned high praise from the residents, fully encapsulating our empathetic values.

  • Passionate. Going the Extra Mile • Sincere. Showing Deep Care

    A lone little black dog was found outside the bustling mall. Our observant colleague noticed the collar and realized the dog was likely lost from a nearby home. They approached the dog, patiently calming it, and notified other colleagues for assistance. Working as a team, they checked CCTV footage to trace the dog's origins, cared for the dog, explained the situation to onlookers, and searched for the owner around the mall. Eventually, they reunited the dog with its owner. Their dedication and teamwork not only demonstrated a spirit of compassion but also left a lasting impression on the customers, who later made a thank-you card for them in appreciation.

  • Professional. Acting with Swiftness

    A swarm of bees recently invaded a resident's unit, causing the family to flee in terror. The resident, clutching their child, urgently sought help from our service center. Three of our staff, equipped with protective gear, quickly arrived to handle the bees and remove the hive outside the window. The resident marveled at their versatility and highly praised their efforts. Our colleagues had previously learned pest control techniques during meetings with extermination companies, equipping themselves with knowledge to handle emergencies. Their proactive approach, calm demeanor, and teamwork were truly commendable. The resident's appreciation further motivated the team to continue enhancing their skills and provide comprehensive management services.

  • Attentive. Listening to Every Need • Flexible. Embracing Innovative Thinking

    Smart robots are increasingly integrated into our daily lives, playing a significant role in property management. Recently, our estate introduced various types of smart assistants to lighten the workload and improve service quality. For instance, the estate's clubhouse restaurant now has a smart delivery robot. Beyond tirelessly delivering meals, it also surprises residents with special moments, orchestrated by our thoughtful colleagues. For example, during a child's birthday celebration at the restaurant, the robot delivered a cake and sang a birthday song, charming the child. This creative use of technology, combined with our colleagues' playful ideas, left the young resident with unforgettable and joyful memories.
